bundle_method: Explicit field and line whitelist from nine existing capture files; no new run.

redaction.configuration.json: Only listed technical fields, blob digests/sizes and runtime environment settings retained; all file paths, account settings and unrelated runtime state omitted.
redaction.startup.json: Version and model metadata retained; listener reduced to the probe loopback address; process information omitted.
redaction.summary.json: Only probe status, task results, model/context/allocation and scope fields retained; unrelated runtime state omitted.
redaction.server.log: Only the documented device/offload/context/speculative-decoding line numbers retained.
redaction.samenvatting.md: Not copied; only technical facts are restated in README.md.

integrity_scope: Source hashes identify the original capture files. Blob digest names and sizes were recorded during the probe; weight files were not rehashed for this bundle.
